description: Capricorn decan 1 (December 22 to December 31): personality, love, work and growth, with Saturn as sub-ruler of the first ten degrees of Capricorn.
answer: In Western astrology, the first decan of Capricorn covers 0° to 9° of the sign, roughly December 22 to December 31, with Saturn as its sub-ruler, the sign's own planet. It is read as discipline, patience and long-range ambition in their most classic form.

sections.heading: Capricorn decan 1 personality
paragraphs: Saturn governs Capricorn and also takes the sub-ruler role in its opening ten degrees, so this is the sign at its most concentrated. Traditionally that brings seriousness, self-discipline and a long view of time. People here are often described as mature beyond their years when young and surprisingly playful later on, as if they have earned the right to relax. They tend to respect structure, tradition and competence, and they measure progress in years rather than weeks. Responsibility often arrives early, sometimes before they are ready, and they usually rise to meet it with a quiet determination that others mistake for coldness.

Doubled Saturn brings remarkable stamina. These Capricorns can keep going when motivation has long since faded, relying on habit and principle instead of mood. Their humour is often dry and understated. The difficulty lies in the weight they carry: self-criticism, fear of failure and a belief that rest must be earned can wear them down. Feelings may be managed rather than expressed. Yet Saturn's lessons tend to pay off over time, and this decan is frequently linked with achievement that comes from persistence rather than flair. When they temper their standards with self-compassion, their reliability becomes a foundation that other people can build upon.

sections.heading: Capricorn decan 1 in love and at work
paragraphs: In love, the first decan of Capricorn tends to be cautious, loyal and serious about commitment. Fleeting romance rarely interests them; they would rather invest slowly in something durable. Affection is often shown through practical support, keeping promises and planning a shared future. Emotional expressiveness may take time, and early on they can seem reserved. Partners who are patient, dependable and respectful of their ambitions usually discover a steady warmth beneath the composure. Letting themselves be looked after, rather than always being the responsible one, can bring a welcome softness to their relationships over the years.

Professionally, doubled Saturn is often suited to management, administration, engineering, architecture, accounting, government, project leadership and any role that rewards reliability and long-term planning. They tend to climb steadily, building expertise and reputation through consistent effort. Colleagues trust them to deliver. Authority sits comfortably on their shoulders. The risk is workaholism or rigidity, holding on to procedures after they have stopped being useful. Building in genuine rest, and occasionally experimenting with new methods, keeps their competence fresh. Their greatest professional asset is often patience: they are still working on the goal after others have quietly drifted away.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Capricorn decan 1: what Saturn adds
paragraphs: The first decan covers 0° to 9° of Capricorn, which in most years means birthdays from December 22 to December 31. First decans take the sign's own ruler, so Saturn rules both the sign and this decan, which is why it is often called the purest expression of Capricorn. The other two decans of Capricorn belong to Venus (decan 2) and Mercury (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Saturn contributes discipline, patience and a sense of responsibility. Under its sub-rulership a sign is said to take itself more seriously, plan for the long term, respect structure and earn confidence slowly through steady achievement. Saturnine decans are often linked with management, craft, institutions and long apprenticeships, and their usual lesson is to allow rest and lightness alongside duty. Here Saturn doubles up with the sign's own ruler, so Capricorn's ambition, discipline, patience and dry, steady resilience come through with little filtering.

sections.heading: Growth for Capricorn decan 1
paragraphs: The growth edge for this decan often involves loosening the grip of the inner critic. Recognising progress, not just pointing out shortfalls, can change how sustainable their efforts feel. Scheduling leisure with the same seriousness as work may sound ironic, yet it often helps. It is also worth asking whether a rule still serves its purpose or simply feels safe. Sharing worries with a trusted friend, rather than shouldering everything alone, lightens the load. Their discipline is a remarkable strength. Allowing joy and spontaneity alongside it tends to make their achievements feel genuinely satisfying, not merely completed.

Within Capricorn, decan 2 leans towards ambition polished with taste, sensuality and a builder's patience and decan 3 leans towards strategic intelligence with an analyst's eye for detail. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Is the first decan of Capricorn the most serious?
faq.answer: It is traditionally seen as the most Saturnine part of the sign, since Saturn is both ruler and sub-ruler. That emphasises discipline, responsibility and long-term ambition. Many natives are also known for dry wit, and the wider chart can bring considerable warmth and playfulness.

faq.question: What are the dates of Capricorn decan 1?
faq.answer: In most years December 22 to December 31, the days when the Sun is between 0° and 9° of Capricorn. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Capricorn decan 1?
faq.answer: Saturn. In the triplicity system each earth sign's decans take the rulers of the earth signs in order, starting with Capricorn's own ruler, Saturn.
